title: Maximal voluntary right lateral exertion: primary and coupled moments about L5-S1, males (semi-seated dynamometer)
condition: isometric maximal right lateral exertion, semi-seated, pelvis and legs fixed

quantity.name: MVE moment (primary and coupled)
quantity.definition: moments about S1 (L5-S1) measured by triaxial dynamometer (three AMTI force platforms) during ~8 s isometric maximal exertion; trial with the larger primary moment of two; sign: + flexion, + right lateral bending, + right axial rotation; pct_of_primary = coupled/primary as printed in Table 2

source.authors: Ghezelbash F, El Ouaaid Z, Shirazi-Adl A, Plamondon A, Arjmand N
source.sample: healthy young right-handed males, in vivo

protocol.summary: Two ~8 s isometric MVE trials per direction (flexion, extension, right/left lateral bending, right/left axial rotation) in the semi-seated triaxial dynamometer of Lariviere et al. (2001); pelvis and legs fixed, hands crossed on chest, verbal encouragement, 2 min rest; dynamometer signals 128 Hz; moments reported about S1.
how_to_simulate: Semi-seated posture, pelvis fixed; paper's model prescribed lordosis reduced by 11 deg (+10 deg rotation at S1, -1 deg at L1).

Apply the harness reaction at the subject-machine contact (shoulder joint height), offset so the moments about S1 equal the measured primary and coupled moments (sign: + flexion, + right lateral, + right axial).
Arms crossed on chest; upper-body gravity scaled to the subject's body weight and height.

Compare the model's moments about L5-S1 (primary and coupled) with data; if the model predicts strength, compare its maximal primary moment, or report the required maximum muscle stress (paper: mean 0.80±0.42 MPa).

subject_model.source: Methods text (lines 72-73): mean±SD of the sex group

protocol.notes: Coupled-moment directions varied among subjects (e.g. left axial MVE: 9 subjects coupled extension vs 10 flexion), so signed means are small with large SD. Table 2 also lists Ng et al. (2001, 12 males) and Lariviere et al. (2009, 20 males, absolute values) - those are literature copies, not extracted here. Female vs male ANOVA p-values in Table 1 (primary moments significantly different except flexion).

extraction.check_notes: All 9 mean/SD/% values re-compared with the rendered Table 2 (PDF p.17).

pass_rule.rule: |model-mean| <= 1 SD for primary moment; coupled moments: sign and magnitude within 1 SD
